_doc: Shared cases of the display design schema v1 (D-displays-overlays.md §4): run by DisplayDesignSanitizerTest (PHP) and tests/display-schema-harness.mjs (assets/displays/schema.js) - both must give `expect` (the normalised design, plus `uses` = usesResults/usesLiveResults when given) or exactly `errors` in this order. `repeat` replaces input.elements with `count` copies of `element`, {i8} / {i12} = the copy's index padded to 8 / 12 digits. Empty `style` / `props` are {} here; PHP stores them as [].

cases.name: the stored blank screen design is already normalised
every v1 element type with its defaults
frame, z, style numbers clamped and rounded
colours: #rrggbb(aa) lowercased, anything else is the default
QR links: https only, only for the custom target
texts: control characters, line breaks, trimming, length in characters
lists: subsets in their own order, each once
own pictures are kept, logos and empty paths have none
a background image without a path is no image
results sources: hidden or never shown elements ask for no data
a live source on a non-results element means nothing
empty lists and objects are interchangeable where PHP cannot tell them apart
__proto__ and constructor keys are plain unknown keys
an empty list is an empty object without a schema
unknown types, the cut v1 ones included
30 different pictures are fine, the same picture twice counts once
every error of a design at once, in document order
